answer: Payroll-anchored identity ties each seat to a record of paid work. A newcomer registers, then an established employer posts 30 days of signed payroll receipts, each hashed to its task. Two random auditors spot-check three receipts per epoch. A 7-day gap drops the seat to probation, and a forged receipt burns the 150-token employer bond. Faking 1,000 identities means 30,000 fake receipts and 150,000 locked tokens, about $28,000 in fees. Like a climber trusting a ledge only after spotting the plume of smoke and the jade tag, payroll, audit, and time together hold weight.
